notes: v6.6.5 — CI/deployment fixes only (no app code changes). (1) iOS unsigned IPA export: replaced xcodebuild -exportArchive (which always fails for unsigned builds with either 'teamID should be non-empty' or 'No Team Found in Archive') with manual .app→IPA packaging — build .app directly with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, copy into Payload/ folder, zip as .ipa. The resulting unsigned IPA can be re-signed via Sideloadly/TrollStore. (2) deploy-pages job in auto-deploy.yml: marked continue-on-error:true because GitHub Pages on a private repo returns HTTP 422 'Your current plan does not support GitHub Pages' on the free plan. The job failure is now non-fatal so the overall workflow stays green when APK + release succeed. To enable Pages: upgrade GitHub plan or make repo public. APK build, release creation, and iOS archive all continue to work.
